symptom: `alter association … set owner both` reports "Altered association" and mx check then fails CE0066 "Entity access is out of date" — on a same-module association at its own module (PedApp Administration.AccountPasswordData_Account), and on a cross-module one at the TO entity's module (MyFirstModule.Note_Account → CE0066 at Domain model of module 'Administration'). `update security` printed "All entity access rules are up to date" over the cross-module case.
cause: Two gaps. (1) execAlterAssociation wrote the owner and never called ReconcileMemberAccesses (nor tracked the domain model for the finalize pass), unlike create/drop association. (2) ReconcileMemberAccesses only reads the domain model it is handed; OWNER Both on a CrossAssociation makes it a member of the TO entity in ANOTHER module, and nothing in that module's domain model records it — so even a reconcile of the TO module added nothing, and a stale entry (Both → Default) was kept forever by the 'preserve foreign references' branch.
insight: Membership of an entity is not a property of its own domain model: a cross-module association under OWNER Both makes it a member of an entity in a module the reconcile never reads. Any write that changes owner must reconcile BOTH ends' modules, and the reconcile of a module must scan other modules' CrossAssociations whose ChildQualifiedName points into it — the only place the fact is stored. The same-module half was already handled by the Both branch in reconcile (issuetracker #20); the defect there was only that alter never called it.
test: mdl/backend/modelsdk/reconcile_cross_owner_both_test.go TestReconcile_CrossModuleOwnerBothAddsTheToEntitysEntry; mdl/executor/cmd_associations_alter_reconcile_test.go TestAlterAssociation_OwnerReconcilesBothEnds; mx check on PedApp copies (11.13): CE0066 before, clean after (same-module, cross-module Both, cross-module back to Default, update-security repair of a project broken by the old binary)
